description: Follow the release check of a publish: its status, each check's run with its checker, effect, and status, each blocking result with the file and line or package, the rule, and how to fix it, each advisory result the same way (advisory results never block), what deploy did with the release, and what to do next. Omit check_id for the service's latest check. Pass wait_seconds 20 to wait up to 20 seconds for the check or the deploy to change before answering. While the answer carries retry_after_seconds, call again with wait_seconds 20: a passed check's release goes live, and a blocked or errored one's is refused, shortly after. Requires connecting a Valet account.

check_id.description: The check's id, from a publish. Omit to read the service's latest check.

name.description: Required. The website's, app's, or agent's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the check's status or the deploy's state to change before answering. Default 0 answers at once. Use 20 while the answer carries retry_after_seconds.

name: get_check
title: Get a release check
